description: Pages and databases by title, in every workspace at once unless account names one. Notion matches words in titles, not in page bodies. Each hit says its workspace, kind, id and parent; a database hit also carries the dataSourceId of its table. Only what is shared with the workspace's integration can be found. A workspace that fails is listed under failed, beside the others' hits.

account.description: Workspace: a label list_accounts names ("*": every one). Rarely needed: an id or URL finds its own.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, exactly as it came back, to read on.

limit.description: Hits per workspace; across several workspaces, up to this many from each.

query.description: Words in the title. Leave it out to list everything, newest edit first.

name: search
title: Search
